summary: The exact candidate fixes the original mixed-dtype indexed store, the ordinary and MIS Triton prefill paths, and PAD_SLOT_ID skip semantics. Independent gfx950 numerical and compiler-path tests found no remaining counterexample in the source-level contract.

tests.what_was_measured: Reproduced both indexed-store dtype failures and both real Triton new_conv_state branch-type compilation failures; confirmed MIS bypassed the absent helper. The fixture records expected failures without exiting nonzero.

Both original store directions and both prior compiler counterexamples passed; output and final state matched an independent grouped-convolution reference; padded cache row stayed unchanged; MIS used the helper.
Candidate four-way GPU regression passed for FP16/BF16, BF16/FP32, BF16/FP16, and BF16/BF16 activation/cache pairs.
Candidate MIS and padded mixed-cache regression matched independent grouped-convolution output and state references for FP32 and FP16 caches.
Independent FP16/BF16 multi-slot case covered noncontiguous slots, empty padded segment, initial/no-initial branches, numerical output/state references, and untouched unrelated rows.
19 focused policy/backend tests and 27 subtests passed.
Existing GPU causal-convolution cloned-query-state regression passed.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, HIP 7.2.26015; real Triton compilation and numerical GPU kernels executed.

remaining_limitations: QuantTrio/Qwen3.6-27B-AWQ weights and the full qwen3_5 serving path were unavailable.
The reporter's NVIDIA RTX 5090, SM120, and CUDA 13.3 environment was unavailable; validation used one AMD Instinct MI355X/gfx950 with ROCm 7.2.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
No full-model semantic-accuracy or multi-node claim is made.
